schedule: A actual future lane schedule given, same for frozen and rolling; not B arrival forecast or causal scheduler evaluation
energy_available: only complete ten-second windows ending<=120; 35..115 union, not full120
rolling_power: delta W = last available up-to10s observed mean W minus same past interval frozen state mean W; constant correction over next10s
rolling_ap: last available AP minus original prediction at that observation time, propagated with frozen beta; original latent H and reference kept
persistence: last available AP held, past available mean whole-device W held; no future schedule input
availability: AP after_ns upper bracket; power event mono_ns publication proxy; host delivery and sensor hardware refresh not certified
role: no parameter fitting or window tuning; development6, confirmation6, prior sustained8 reported separately
primary_metrics: per-session mean AP path MAE at actual valid within-window query times
